statement: Every committed frame of a walk is judged by P2, P4 and P-BELIEF, including the frames of the dispute lifecycle (P1's ticks) and the at-rest settle ticks; no frame of a walk goes unjudged.
source: Review A of PR 69, F4 (core 0x30de1: 34 of 41 frames judged, disputes 0x30de1: 136 of 143; the capacity probe's frames are judged since #69)
